arxiv-1407-3561.title: IPFS - Content Addressed, Versioned, P2P File System (DRAFT 3)
arxiv-1407-3561.creator: Juan Benet
arxiv-1407-3561.description: Abstract The InterPlanetary File System (IPFS) is a peer-to-peer distributed file system that seeks to connect all computing devices with the same system of files. In some ways, IPFS is similar to the Web, but IPFS could be seen as a single BitTorrent swarm, exchanging objects within one Git repository.

arxiv-1502-00603.title: Collision Geometry and Flow in Uranium+Uranium Collisions
arxiv-1502-00603.creator: Andy Goldschmidt, Zhi Qiu, Chun Shen, Ulrich Heinz, [1ex] Department of Physics, The Ohio State UniversityColumbus, OH 43210, USA
arxiv-1502-00603.description: Abstract Using event-by-event viscous fluid dynamics to evolve fluctuating initial density profiles from the Monte-Carlo Glauber model for U+U collisions, we report a “knee”-like structure in the elliptic flow as a function of collision centrality, located near 0.5% centrality as measured by the final charged multiplicity.

arxiv-2008-00076.title: Possibility conditions for Open Access
arxiv-2008-00076.creator: Jacinto Dávila
arxiv-2008-00076.description: Abstract This is an attempt to formalize the conditions of possibility for free, libre, open access to scientific knowledge within a game. The challenge is to enunciate the terms under which agents participating in the "Grand conversation" of science would be willing to open share, exchange, negotiate or surrender their contributions, considering their corresponding intentions, goals, beliefs and expected utilities.

arxiv-2012-10595.title: T-GAP : Learning to Walk across Time for Temporal Knowledge Graph Completion
arxiv-2012-10595.creator: Jaehun Jung, Jinhong Jung, U Kang, Department of Computer Science, Seoul National University Department of Computer Science, Jeonbuk National University sharkmir1@snu.ac.kr, jinhongjung@jbnu.ac.kr, ukang@snu.ac.kr
arxiv-2012-10595.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Jaehun Jung, Jinhong Jung, U Kang, Department of Computer Science, Seoul National University Department of Computer Science, Jeonbuk National University sharkmir1@snu.ac.kr, jinhongjung@jbnu.ac.kr, ukang@snu.ac.kr. Temporal knowledge graphs (TKGs) inherently reflect the transient nature of real-world knowledge, as opposed to static knowledge graphs. Naturally, automatic TKG completion has drawn much research interests for a more realistic modeling of relational reasoning.

arxiv-2108-08468.creator: Danqing Zhang* 1 , Zheng Li* 1 , Tianyu Cao 1 , Chen Luo 1 , Tony Wu 1 , Hanqing Lu 1 , Yiwei Song 1 , Bing Yin 1 , Tuo Zhao 2 , Qiang Yang 3
arxiv-2108-08468.description: Abstract . We study the problem of query attribute value extraction, which aims to identify named entities from user queries as diverse surface form attribute values and afterward transform them into formally canonical forms. Such a problem consists of two phases: named entity recognition (NER) and attribute value normalization (AVN).

arxiv-2112-05383.title: Dandelion-Picking Legged Robot
arxiv-2112-05383.creator: Sandilya Sai Garimella, Shai Revzen
arxiv-2112-05383.description: Abstract Agriculture is currently undergoing a robotics revolution, but robots using wheeled or treads suffer from known disadvantages: they are unable to move over rubble and steep or loose ground, and they trample continuous strips of land thereby reducing the viable crop area. Legged robots offer an alternative, but existing commercial legged robots are complex, expensive, and hard to maintain.

arxiv-2408-03482.title: Beyond App Markets: Demystifying Underground Mobile App Distribution Via Telegram
arxiv-2408-03482.creator: Yanhui Guo, Dong Wang, Liu Wang, Yongsheng Fang, Chao Wang, Minghui Yang, Tianming Liu, Haoyu Wang
arxiv-2408-03482.description: Abstract . The thriving mobile app ecosystem encompasses a wide range of functionalities. However, within this ecosystem, a subset of apps provides illicit services such as gambling and pornography to pursue economic gains, collectively referred to as "underground economy apps".

arxiv-2410-23955.title: An Empirical Analysis of Speech Self-Supervised Learning at Multiple Resolutions
arxiv-2410-23955.creator: Theo Clark, Benedetta Cevoli, Eloy de Jong
arxiv-2410-23955.description: Abstract Self-supervised learning (SSL) models have become crucial in speech processing, with recent advancements concentrating on developing architectures that capture representations across multiple timescales. The primary goal of these multi-scale architectures is to exploit the hierarchical nature of speech, where lower-resolution components aim to capture representations that align with increasingly abstract concepts (e.g., from phones to words to sentences).

arxiv-2502-03302.title: MAP Image Recovery with Guarantees using Locally Convex Multi-Scale Energy (LC-MUSE) Model
arxiv-2502-03302.creator: Jyothi Rikhab Chand, Mathews Jacob *
arxiv-2502-03302.description: Abstract We propose a multi-scale deep energy model that is strongly convex in the local neighbourhood around the data manifold to represent its probability density, with application in inverse problems. In particular, we represent the negative log-prior as a multi-scale energy model parameterized by a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN).

pmc-11338794.title: Physical exercise for brain plasticity promotion an overview of the underlying oscillatory mechanism
pmc-11338794.creator: Xueyang Li, Xuehong Qu, Kaixuan Shi, Yichen Yang, Jizhe Sun
pmc-11338794.description: The global recognition of the importance of physical exercise (PE) for human health has resulted in increased research on its effects on cortical activity. Neural oscillations, which are prominent features of brain activity, serve as crucial indicators for studying the effects of PE on brain function. Existing studies support the idea that PE modifies various types of neural oscillations.

pmc-11742885.title: Beyond Classic Leprosy: Exploring Atypical Manifestations and Their Diagnostic Challenges
pmc-11742885.creator: Aruna Bathina, Haritha Kollipara, Gedela Sravani, Vijaya Sree Laxmi
pmc-11742885.description: Leprosy, or Hansen’s disease, is an ancient infectious disease characterized by varied clinical presentations influenced by the host's immune response. This study aimed to explore the atypical manifestations of Hansen’s disease in a cohort of 15 biopsy-confirmed patients admitted to the Department of Dermatology, Venereology & Leprosy at a tertiary care center in Andhra Pradesh, India.

pmc-12614828.title: Clinical characteristics and histopathologic features of movable inflammatory laryngeal masses in five dogs
pmc-12614828.creator: Aki FUJIWARA-IGARASHI, Sho GOTO, Yuta NAKAZAWA, Takafumi OHSHIMA, Haruyoshi TETSU, Kenichi INABA, Yukino MACHIDA, Masaki MICHISHITA
pmc-12614828.description: Information on inflammatory laryngeal masses in dogs remains extremely limited. We aimed to describe the clinical and histopathological features and outcomes of five dogs with bilateral, movable inflammatory laryngeal masses. Stridor was a common clinical sign, followed by dysphonia and snoring, all of which were mild.

pmc-12814992.title: Clinical and Financial Impacts of Late Referral in Patients With Chronic Kidney Disease: A Narrative Review
pmc-12814992.creator: Rana Abou Mrad, Mohamed A Salman
pmc-12814992.description: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is a worldwide burden on healthcare systems. As the disease severity progresses, CKD patients are at high risk of morbidity, mortality, and renal replacement therapy. The cost of care for these conditions is substantially high and increases as the disease progresses.

pmc-13272098.title: Perception, Knowledge and Attitudes About Organ Donation in Nursing Students at the University of Málaga
pmc-13272098.creator: Jorge Vallejo‐Báez, Antonio Zamudio‐Sánchez, Adolfo Romero‐Arana, Ana Rebollo‐Rubio, Adolfo Romero‐Ruiz
pmc-13272098.description: BackgroundOrgan transplants are currently the most effective treatment for end‐stage organ failure and are sometimes the only option. They can affect the life expectancy of patients who depend on treatments that seriously compromise their quality of life. Various studies have been conducted to ascertain opinions, perceptions and attitudes toward organ donation among different sectors of society, including healthcare professionals.
